stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 20 hours and pipe B can fill it in 20 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the cistern? (2 decimal places, in hours.)
solutionMarkdown: A's rate $= 1/20$ of the cistern per hour, B's rate $= 1/20$. Combined rate $= 1/20 + 1/20 = 0.1000$ per hour. Time together $= \dfrac{1}{1/20+1/20} = 10.00$ hours.
